colors.terminal.ansiBlack.why: dark's ansiBlack is the recessed surface, which maps to near-white; a light terminal needs the text colour

colors.terminal.ansiBrightWhite.why: the map made it the darkest text; bright white must stay lighter than ansiWhite

colors.editor.findMatchBackground.why: mapped honey is dark brown; the original honey hex as a translucent wash reads as a highlight on light

colors.scrollbar.shadow.why: dark shadow colour maps to a light surface, which is invisible; a shadow must be dark

colors.scrollbarSlider.background.why: mapped surface hex is nearly the background colour, so the slider vanished; use the comment purple
